description: Consolidate sidebar navigation from 15 items across 4 groups down to 7-8 items across 2-3 groups. Merge overlapping pages: combine Review/Revision/Mistakes into single 'Review' nav item, combine Insights/Weekly Report/LOS Tracker into single 'Analytics' nav item, keep Questions and Practice separate but remove redundant 'Practice' since Questions page already has practice features. Keep Learn, Flashcards, and Dashboard.
steps: Modify src/shared/config/navigation.ts to consolidate navigation groups. New structure: (1) 'Core' group: Dashboard, Questions, Flashcards, Learn; (2) 'Review' group: Review (smart review queue), Mistakes; (3) 'Analytics' group: Insights (merge weekly report + LOS tracker here via tabs). Total: 7 items max. Remove separate Practice entry (fold into Questions), remove separate Revision (merge into Review), remove Exam Plan (fold into profile/settings), remove Resources (fold into Learn), remove Formulas (fold into Learn).
Update mobileNavItems in navigation.ts to reflect new structure: Dashboard, Questions, Flashcards, Learn, Review (5 items).
Update routeSegmentLabels to match new navigation if routes change.

Simplify src/shared/components/layout/sidebar.tsx - remove collapsible group headers since we have fewer items now. Make it a flat list with simple section dividers. Add more whitespace between items. Make the sidebar feel cleaner and more minimal.
Ensure all existing routes still work (don't delete any route files), just remove from nav. Pages that are no longer in nav are still accessible via links within other pages.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar shows max 7-8 navigation items total
Sidebar has at most 2-3 logical groups with simple dividers (not collapsible accordions)
All existing page routes still render (no broken imports)
verification: rm -rf .next && eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run lint
eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npm run build
